version: "3"

tasks:
  default:
    desc: Local gate (fmt, clippy, test, deny)
    cmds:
      - task: check

  fmt:
    desc: cargo fmt --check
    cmds:
      - cargo fmt --all -- --check

  clippy:
    desc: cargo clippy -D warnings
    cmds:
      - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

  test:
    desc: cargo test --locked
    cmds:
      - cargo test --workspace --locked

  deny:
    desc: cargo deny advisories + bans
    cmds:
      - cargo deny check advisories bans

  check:
    desc: Sequential fmt, clippy, test, deny (do not parallelize — cargo target lock)
    cmds:
      - task: fmt
      - task: clippy
      - task: test
      - task: deny

  docker:
    desc: Build ollama-router:local
    cmds:
      - docker build -t ollama-router:local .

  compose:up:
    desc: Start Grafana/Prometheus/Loki (loopback :3000 / :9090); scrape native router on host :11435
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d
      - cmd: |
          if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11435/healthz >/dev/null; then
            echo "Grafana http://127.0.0.1:3000 — Prometheus scrape of host :11435 is up"
          else
            echo "Grafana http://127.0.0.1:3000 will show 0 nodes until the native router is up." >&2
            echo "Host Ollama stays on :11434. In another terminal: task dev" >&2
            echo "(router :11435 → Ollama :11434, agent :11436)" >&2
          fi
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  compose:mock:
    desc: Build and start the canned mock CPU+GPU fleet plus Grafana/Prometheus/Loki (loopback :11435 / :3000 / :9090)
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.mock.yaml up --build -d

  compose:down:
    desc: Stop compose and mock compose (keeps grafana-data; no -v)
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml down --remove-orphans
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.mock.yaml down --remove-orphans

  compose:restart:
    desc: Restart compose observability services
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml restart

  compose:ps:
    desc: Show compose observability status
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml ps

  compose:logs:
    desc: Follow compose observability logs
    cmds:
      - docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs -f

  obs:open:
    desc: Print local Grafana dashboard URLs (fleet overview, nodes, model operations, logs, verda, stack)
    cmds:
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ollama-router/ollama-router
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ollama-router-nodes/ollama-router-nodes
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ollama-router-jobs/ollama-router-jobs
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ollama-router-logs/ollama-router-logs
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ollama-router-verda/ollama-router-verda
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/compose-scrapes/compose-scrapes
      - echo http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboards?tag=stack

  agent:serve:
    desc: Native node-agent on loopback :11436 (deploy/agent.local.yaml; does not run setup)
    cmds:
      - cargo run -p ollama-node-agent --locked -- serve --config deploy/agent.local.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11436

  router:serve:
    desc: Native router on :11435 against host Ollama (deploy/fleet.local.yaml)
    env:
      OLLAMA_ROUTER_FLEET: deploy/fleet.local.yaml
      OLLAMA_ROUTER_CONFIG: deploy/router.local.yaml
      OLLAMA_ROUTER_STATE_FILE: .local/ollama-router/fleet-state.json
      OLLAMA_ROUTER_HOST: "0.0.0.0"
      OLLAMA_ROUTER_PORT: "11435"
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p .local/ollama-router
      - cargo run -p ollama-router --locked -- serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 11435

  dev:
    desc: Build once, then agent :11436 + router :11435 against host Ollama :11434
    cmds:
      - cargo build --locked -p ollama-router -p ollama-node-agent
      - cmd: |
          if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null; then
            echo "host Ollama is not reachable at http://127.0.0.1:11434" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p .local/ollama-router
          ./target/debug/ollama-node-agent serve --config deploy/agent.local.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11436 &

doc.text:
dev:
    desc: Build once, then agent :11436 + router :11435 against host Ollama :11434
    cmds:
      - cargo build --locked -p ollama-router -p ollama-node-agent
      - cmd: |
          if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null; then
            echo "host Ollama is not reachable at http://127.0.0.1:11434" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p .local/ollama-router
          ./target/debug/ollama-node-agent serve --config deploy/agent.local.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11436 &
          AGENT_PID=$!
          trap 'kill "$AGENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
          export OLLAMA_ROUTER_FLEET=deploy/fleet.local.yaml
          export OLLAMA_ROUTER_CONFIG=deploy/router.local.yaml
          export OLLAMA_ROUTER_STATE_FILE=.local/ollama-router/fleet-state.json
          export OLLAMA_ROUTER_HOST=0.0.0.0
          export OLLAMA_ROUTER_PORT=11435
          echo "Ollama :11434 → router :11435, agent :11436" >&2
          ./target/debug/ollama-router serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 11435
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:build:
    desc: Build ollama-node-agent
    cmds:
      - cargo build -p ollama-node-agent --locked

  agent:test:
    desc: Test ollama-node-agent (workspace `check` already covers this crate)
    cmds:
      - cargo test -p ollama-node-agent --locked

  agent:doctor:
    desc: Read-only node-agent report for this machine (no side effects)
    cmds:
      - cargo run -p ollama-node-agent --locked -- doctor

  agent:release:
    desc: Host-OS agent artifacts into dist/agent
    cmds:
      - task: agent:release:linux
        platforms: [linux]
      - task: agent:release:deb
        platforms: [linux]
      - task: agent:release:macos
        platforms: [darwin]
      - task: agent:release:windows
        platforms: [windows]

  agent:release:linux:
    desc: musl tarball for this host via Docker rust:1.97-slim-bookworm
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
            aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
            *) echo "unsupported arch $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          bash crates/ollama-node-agent/packaging/linux/release-in-docker.sh \
            musl "$ARCH" dist/agent
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:release:deb:
    desc: gnu bookworm .deb for this host via Docker rust:1.97-slim-bookworm
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
            aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
            *) echo "unsupported arch $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          VER=$(awk '/^\[workspace.package\]/{p=1;next} p&&/^version =/{gsub(/"/,"",$3); print $3; exit}' Cargo.toml)
          bash crates/ollama-node-agent/packaging/linux/release-in-docker.sh \
            gnu "$ARCH" dist/agent "$VER"
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:release:macos:
    desc: .pkg plus unsigned zip for this host (macOS; GHA macos-14 is canonical)
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          if [[ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ]]; then
            echo "skipping Darwin pkg: requires macos-14 host (GHA is canonical)" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            x86_64) ARCH=amd64; TARGET=x86_64-apple-darwin ;;
            arm64) ARCH=arm64; TARGET=aarch64-apple-darwin ;;
            *) echo "unsupported arch $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          VER=$(awk '/^\[workspace.package\]/{p=1;next} p&&/^version =/{gsub(/"/,"",$3); print $3; exit}' Cargo.toml)
          rustup target add "$TARGET"
          cargo build --release --locked -p ollama-node-agent --target "$TARGET"
          bash crates/ollama-node-agent/packaging/macos/pack-pkg.sh \
            "target/${TARGET}/release/ollama-node-agent" "$ARCH" "$VER" dist/agent
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:release:windows:
    desc: portable exe plus MSI (Windows MSVC host; WiX v5 for MSI)
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          HOST=$(rustc -vV | awk '/^host:/{print $2}')
          if [[ "$HOST" != x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ]]; then
            echo "skipping Windows MSI: requires windows-latest / MSVC host (GHA is canonical)" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          VER=$(awk '/^\[workspace.package\]/{p=1;next} p&&/^version =/{gsub(/"/,"",$3); print $3; exit}' Cargo.toml)
          cargo build --release --locked -p ollama-node-agent
          mkdir -p dist/agent
          cp target/release/ollama-node-agent.exe dist/agent/ollama-node-agent-windows-amd64.exe
          if ! command -v wix >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "skipping Windows MSI: wix not on PATH (install WiX v5; GHA is canonical)" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          bash crates/ollama-node-agent/packaging/windows/pack-msi.sh \
            target/release/ollama-node-agent.exe "$VER" dist/agent
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:release:github:
    desc: Dispatch Release node agent via gh and flatten artifacts into dist/agent (gh auth)

mkdir -p dist/agent
          cp target/release/ollama-node-agent.exe dist/agent/ollama-node-agent-windows-amd64.exe
          if ! command -v wix >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "skipping Windows MSI: wix not on PATH (install WiX v5; GHA is canonical)" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          bash crates/ollama-node-agent/packaging/windows/pack-msi.sh \
            target/release/ollama-node-agent.exe "$VER" dist/agent
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  agent:release:github:
    desc: Dispatch Release node agent via gh and flatten artifacts into dist/agent (gh auth)
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "install GitHub CLI (gh) and run: gh auth login  (scopes: repo, workflow)" >&2
            echo "or set GH_TOKEN. Push the current branch/tag first." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "gh auth required: gh auth login  (scopes: repo, workflow) or set GH_TOKEN" >&2
            echo "Push the current branch/tag first — workflow_dispatch only sees remote refs." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if git symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null; then
            REF=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
          else
            REF=$(git describe --tags --exact-match 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD)
          fi
          SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          echo "dispatching Release node agent for ref ${REF} (${SHA})" >&2
          BEFORE=$(gh run list --workflow="Release node agent" --commit "$SHA" \
            --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
          gh workflow run "Release node agent" --ref "$REF"
          RUN_ID=""
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            RUN_ID=$(gh run list --workflow="Release node agent" --commit "$SHA" \
              --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [[ -n "$RUN_ID" && "$RUN_ID" != "$BEFORE" ]]; then
              break
            fi
            RUN_ID=""
            sleep 2
          done
          if [[ -z "$RUN_ID" ]]; then
            echo "no workflow run appeared for ${SHA} within 60s; is ${REF} pushed?" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          gh run watch "$RUN_ID" --exit-status
          mkdir -p dist/agent
          tmp=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
          gh run download "$RUN_ID" --dir "$tmp"
          find "$tmp" -type f -exec mv {} dist/agent/ \;
          echo "artifacts in dist/agent/" >&2
          ls -1 dist/agent >&2
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  zrok:fetch:
    desc: Download official zrok-instance compose into .local/zrok (no tokens; not vendored)
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          mkdir -p .local/zrok
          if [[ -f .local/zrok/compose.yml || -f .local/zrok/compose.yaml ]]; then
            echo "already fetched: .local/zrok" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          curl -sSfL https://get.openziti.io/zrok-instance/fetch.bash | bash -s "$PWD/.local/zrok"
          if [[ -f .local/zrok/compose.yaml && ! -f .local/zrok/compose.yml ]]; then
            ln -sfn compose.yaml .local/zrok/compose.yml
          fi
          if [[ ! -f .local/zrok/compose.yml ]]; then
            echo "fetch did not produce .local/zrok/compose.yml — see deploy/zrok/README.md" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  zrok:up:
    desc: Start fetched zrok controller/frontend on loopback (see deploy/zrok/README.md)
    cmds:
      - task: zrok:fetch
      - cmd: |
          umask 077
          if [[ ! -f .local/zrok/.env ]]; then
            cp deploy/zrok.env.example .local/zrok/.env
            fill() {
              local key=$1
              if grep -q "^${key}=$" .local/zrok/.env; then
                local val
                val=$(openssl rand -hex 24)
                sed -i "s|^${key}=$|${key}=${val}|" .local/zrok/.env
              fi
            }
            fill ZROK_USER_PWD
            fill ZITI_PWD
            fill ZROK_ADMIN_TOKEN
            echo "wrote .local/zrok/.env (gitignored). Create an enable token next — deploy/zrok/README.md" >&2
          fi
          bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh up -d
          echo "zrok API http://127.0.0.1:18080 — set tunnel.api_endpoint; do not scrape :11436" >&2
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]

  zrok:down:
    desc: Stop fetched zrok compose (keeps .local/zrok volumes unless you pass extra flags)
    cmds:
      - bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh down --remove-orphans

  zrok:ps:
    desc: Show fetched zrok compose status
    cmds:
      - bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh ps

  zrok:logs:
    desc: Follow fetched zrok compose logs
    cmds:
      - bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh logs -f

  zrok:cli:
    desc: docker run zrok CLI against loopback controller (ZROK_API_ENDPOINT)
    cmds:

desc: Show fetched zrok compose status
    cmds:
      - bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh ps

  zrok:logs:
    desc: Follow fetched zrok compose logs
    cmds:
      - bash deploy/zrok/compose.sh logs -f

  zrok:cli:
    desc: docker run zrok CLI against loopback controller (ZROK_API_ENDPOINT)
    cmds:
      - cmd: |
          docker run --rm --network host \
            -e ZROK_API_ENDPOINT="${ZROK_API_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:18080}" \
            docker.io/openziti/zrok:latest version
        sh: [bash, -euo, pipefail, -c]
